acceptance: A preflight run that is interrupted, times out, or exits non-zero at any stage, including while waiting for the heavy lock, writes no passed receipt for its tree.
A test reproduces the interruption during the lock wait and asserts that no passed receipt exists afterwards.
make pr-open refuses a tree whose only receipt comes from an interrupted run.
context: Observed while preparing BenchBox PR #4541. The run was stopped by a harness timeout while it waited for the lock (exit 143), and the receipt for that tree was written as passed. A later full preflight of a newer tree (76f3c65d) ran normally. Out of scope for the derived-paths work; filed at the owner's request.
description: A make pr-preflight run was killed with exit 143 (SIGTERM) while it was still waiting for the shared heavy-work lock, before any test had run. It still wrote a preflight receipt with status passed for that tree under ~/.cache/benchbox/preflight/<tree>.json. make pr-open trusts that receipt, so a tree no test ever ran against can be opened as preflighted.
